topic: F-V01 release/build provenance authority for fixed SQLite runtime admission

trigger_context.go_oob_experiment: NONE; macrocycle OOB slot already consumed in Cycle 1
trigger_context.reason_for_cycle: Cycle 5 target-proved runtime object admission but explicitly left manifest/build trust external. This cycle asks whether an existing owner-fixed trust authority can consume that manifest/artifact without inventing a second trust architecture.

internal_authority_evidence.finding: BootContinuityPolicy already defines the intended provenance consumer: canonical repository, refs/heads/main, SLSA v1 predicate, exact artifact digest, exact source digest/ref and a pinned signer workflow. Missing trusted builder is explicitly fail-closed.

verify_github_attestation() is designed to call gh attestation verify under owner policy, bind the local SHA256 as the verified subject, require source digest/ref and signer workflow, and refuse production caller overrides.

trusted_signer_workflow = none; comment states this is intentionally unresolved until the owner-fixed final v0.1 binary builder exists. evaluate_boot_continuity therefore returns BLOCKED_NO_TRUSTED_BUILDER before build provenance can authorize continuation.
Its earlier target run correctly remained BLOCKED_NO_TRUSTED_BUILDER and also observed /usr/bin/gh absent; no attestation receipt was invented.

Existing private SQLite 3.53.4 lane proves source pinning/private build/runtime compatibility but does not establish an owner-fixed trusted signer workflow or cryptographic artifact attestation authority.

fresh_external_primary_evidence.finding: Artifact attestations establish build provenance only when verified; gh attestation verify can constrain the signer to a specific workflow.
Attestation generation requires attestations:write, contents:read and id-token:write; verification can require --signer-workflow.

For private/internal repositories, artifact attestations are plan-dependent and documented as requiring GitHub Enterprise Cloud. The current repository is private; this worker has not verified an eligible subscription/capability and therefore does not assume availability.
Offline verification is possible with an attestation bundle plus trusted-root material and GitHub CLI, but this does not solve the separate owner-policy problem of which workflow is trusted to sign.

hypothesis.claim: Cycle 5's fixed-SQLite runtime manifest should compose into the existing #231 boot/build provenance consumer rather than gain a storage-specific trust root; once an owner-fixed signer workflow and verifier capability exist, the runtime manifest/artifact can be treated as an attested build subject and then consumed by #324's mapped-object admission.

strongest_counterhypothesis.claim: Because #324 already validates manifest/object hashes locally, the CI-generated manifest itself is sufficient trust authority and no independent attestation/trusted builder is necessary.

adjudication.reason: Local hash consistency proves identity relative to the supplied manifest but cannot prove who was authorized to create that manifest/build. Allowing the same workflow/run to create both candidate bytes and its own trust root would collapse provenance into self-assertion. Existing #231 deliberately separates build verification from identity/state/effect authority.
adjudication.owner_gate: Owner-fixed final v0.1 builder/signer workflow remains explicitly unresolved by current policy.
adjudication.capability_gate: Product repository is private; GitHub artifact-attestation eligibility for the account/plan was not independently established. Do not assume the private-repository attestation service is usable merely because workflow artifacts work.

architecture_delta.name: ONE_BUILD_PROVENANCE_AUTHORITY_FOR_BOOT_AND_RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS
architecture_delta.rule: Do not introduce a storage-specific trusted-builder authority. The accepted fixed-SQLite artifact/manifest must eventually be cryptographically bound by the same owner-fixed build-provenance policy consumed by self.root boot continuity. #324 remains the runtime object admission layer after provenance succeeds, not the provenance root itself.
composition_chain: verified artifact/manifest hash admitted into FRANK_FIXED_SQLITE_RUNTIME_V1

prerequisites: owner selects/pins final or candidate trusted signer workflow under explicit policy
verify repository/account capability for private artifact attestations or select an owner-approved equivalent provenance mechanism
provide verification executable/bundle path on accepted Ubuntu target without relaxing signer/source constraints
next_test_after_owner_gate.test: Attest the immutable fixed-SQLite artifact/manifest from the selected builder, verify it against exact repository/source/ref/signer policy, then run #324 admission. Tampered artifact, wrong source digest, wrong signer workflow and system-library fallback must each fail before Frank state execution.
next_test_after_owner_gate.promotion_rule: A green local hash/admission test without independent provenance remains insufficient.
